result:
I shipped v31.82 (`cw-partylook9`), but no screen has reached a critic score of 4. Three screens (62, 63, 55) got a fix this run. The rest got fresh pictures and critic scores, but I changed nothing on them.

`cw-partylook9` changes the operator card (screens 62 and 63) only:
- **Close X:** it is now 40px (was 48px). It sits centred on the title line, with its right edge on the card's content edge.
- **Focused row:** the lime "new party" row no longer has a second ring around it, so it has one frame.
- **Armed confirm:** the text is now the normal body colour on the danger fill, with the lime bar on its left edge. It was red on maroon at about 3.5 to 1.

The preflight and the ship gate both passed. The seed 4242 fingerprint (ents 85/374, containers 165/593) did not move.

Critic scores after the ship, with the old picture shown first where I had one:

| Screen | Score | Versus before |
|---|---|---|
| 62 operator menu | 3 | better |
| 63 operator, new party armed | 3 | better |
| 55 run over, scored | 3 | better |
| 56 attract board, scored | 3 | better |
| 46 how to play | 3 | same |
| 64 board, seeded night | 2 | same |

I scored 48, 49, 52, 53, 54 and 58 on the before pictures, also below 4. I did not re-shoot them after the ship.

I stopped here under your rule 2.83 b (stop after 6 tries and leave the best versions). The critic keeps asking for changes that either reverse earlier calls or rebuild the card:
- **Card size:** it wants the party cards at about 90% of the screen (your Q43). They are small centred cards on purpose.
- **Backdrop on the operator card:** it wants the dimmed game world behind the card. The backdrop is solid on purpose, because an earlier version let the board's words ghost through it. The live backdrop on the attract pages belongs to task 03.
- **Seeded night code on 64:** it wants the code dropped. The host uses it to match the night.
- **Close X on 46 and 56:** it wants it gone on screens where any key continues. Q43 says a card with an X.

Resizing the party cards to 90% would be a layout rebuild of the attract card, not a restyle, so I left it. Whether to do it is your call.

The best versions are the pictures in `shots/12-r7-after`, with the before set in `shots/12-r7-before`. I logged the change in `notes/ui/changes.md` and the Changes section of `notes/ui/index.html`.

TASK PARTIAL: no listed screen is at 4 yet (46, 52, 55, 56, 58, 62, 63, 64, 48, 49, 53, 54). The next step needs your call on whether the party cards go to the 90% window card and whether the operator card gets the dimmed world behind it.
